values.note: Reservations are required, online through Broome County Parks Reservations or at 607-778-2193; you choose your site number. A walk-in makes a reservation on arrival. Campers must have their equipment with them at registration and occupy the site immediately. A Memorial Day - Labor Day seasonal rate with electric is also sold.

booking.source: https://broomecountyny.gov/parks/greenwood ('Make reservation online by visiting Broome County Parks Reservations [secure.rec1.com/NY/broome-county-ny/catalog] or call 607.778.2193'; 'Reservations are required.'; 'Choose your site number when making a reservation.'; 'Campers must occupy the site immediately'; 'Seasonal Rate (Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day Weekend) with electric is available') + campground brochure 02/23 ('Walk-ins, without prior online reservation, will make a reservation upon arrival'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Mid-May through Columbus Day weekend: weekends only from mid-May, daily Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day, then weekends only through Columbus Day weekend.

season.source: https://broomecountyny.gov/parks/greenwood ('Open beginning mid-May (weekends only; "non-peak season"). Open daily Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day ("peak season"). Open weekends after Labor Day, through Columbus Day Weekend ("non-peak season")'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://broomecountyny.gov/parks/greenwood ('50 sites- electric sites'; '20 and 30 amp service for RV's'; 'Water taps centrally-located within each camping loop'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://broomecountyny.gov/parks/greenwood ('Hot water showers'; 'Water taps centrally-located within each camping loop'; 'Dumping station (for use by those camping at Greenwood Park only)'; 'Camp store (firewood*, ice, snacks, cold drinks, & camping essentials)'), read 2026-10-21

note: Broome County park, Lisle; spring-fed lake with a white sand beach (the camping loop is set back from the lake). --Claude
summary: County page confirms 50 electric sites, $30/night (fees left as read 2026-10-10), reservations required, phone 607-778-2193. Added booking (county rec1 system, choose your site), season (mid-May to Columbus Day weekend, weekends only at the ends), electric 30 amp (20/30), water at central taps not sites, showers, dump, camp store. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: site lengths, pull-throughs, booking window.
flags: Minor: the county also sells a Memorial Day - Labor Day seasonal rate with electric ($1,800 in the 02/23 brochure); the 50 sites are sold nightly to everyone, so this is not a seasonal-only park, but some sites may be held by seasonal campers in summer.
